stage_1_pilot.purpose: Assess acquisition completeness, target mapping, identity, assay-specific class or method-call distribution and source/lab group coverage.
stage_1_pilot.data: Public historical outcomes may be used only as development after reserved candidate exclusion. They are not blinded final evaluation.
stage_1_pilot.metrics: Descriptive distributions and missingness; any model performance is exploratory with uncertainty, never a confirmatory success declaration. No post-hoc reduction of final criteria.
stage_1_pilot.current_limitation: EpiOcular <=60% means no prediction can be made, not a positive eye-irritation label; EpiDerm 15-min, Vitrolife 18/42 and EpiOcular liquid/solid protocols are separate.

stage_2_confirmatory.requirements: Independent original study and material evidence, frozen endpoint and source selection, target-specific model and applicability domain, independent label custodian, fixed decisions and blinded prediction hashes; no known source or related-structure overlap with any development data.
stage_2_confirmatory.sample_planning: Prior 272 accepted/340 eligible per class per endpoint is a worst-case simultaneous confidence-interval width calculation under independent-group and <=20% abstention assumptions, not a paired power calculation. Recalculate before final lock for target CI, source clustering, outcomes and actual expected coverage.
stage_2_confirmatory.paired_power: Formal prospective paired model-comparison power requires predeclared meaningful effect, paired prediction and discordance distributions, chemical/source clustering, class proportions and multiplicity. These remain unspecified; no numeric power claim is made.
stage_2_confirmatory.thresholds: Thresholds, abstention and applicability domain must be determined using development data only, then frozen before final cohort outcomes. Prior 0.4/0.6 working rule is not clinically calibrated and may be replaced only before final cohort unblinding.
